entwurf.titel_zeile2: Let AI Show You Where to Tap
entwurf.beschreibung: bigarrow draws a transparent arrow over your Mac screen to guide you where to tap or copy, without any clicks, types, or recording. It works on macOS 14+ with a single Swift binary. The tool is MIT‑licensed and has no telemetry. It is a pure pointing helper for AI agents needing human interaction.

teile.name: Hook
teile.bildtext: A bright arrow points at a button on a Mac screen.
teile.szene: A modern office desk, morning light, laptop open, an arrow overlays a dialog box.
teile.text: Ever feel stuck when an AI can’t click the button?

teile.name: Problem
teile.bildtext: The screen shows a permission dialog without an arrow.
teile.szene: A darkened macOS Settings window, a subtle overlay appears.
teile.text: The tool can’t press; it only points to the exact spot.

teile.name: Tool
teile.bildtext: A terminal window commands bigarrow to target an app.
teile.szene: A bright terminal on a laptop, command line active, arrow icon visible.
teile.text: Install bigarrow via Swift, then run it like a command.

teile.name: How to Use
teile.bildtext: Command line syntax highlighting the --app flag.
teile.szene: Terminal with syntax highlighting, cursor blinking, bigarrow command highlighted.
teile.text: Use bigarrow --app "App:Window" to target any window.

teile.name: Practical Steps
teile.bildtext: A sign with a copy button beside it on screen.
teile.szene: Screen with overlay sign, a copy button, user clicking it.
teile.text: Embed {{value}} in the sign to copy text, then paste.

teile.name: Limitations
teile.bildtext: The overlay disappears after clicking the target.
teile.szene: Arrow overlay vanishes after user clicks, terminal remains.
teile.text: It never clicks, types, or records—just points and speaks.

teile.name: CTA
teile.bildtext: User smiles after completing task with arrow guidance.
teile.szene: User finishes task, looks satisfied, arrow disappears.
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
